answer: A workable design: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its plume recurs, its pearl survives audit, and a quill from an unlinked peer confirms it.
